group_position: middle shot of grp011 — Alice holds the map start (leaf_heap); the White Rabbit is part way along his root_tunnel -> brick_mid line, still on the root-laced earth stretch.

characters.label: Alice
characters.start_pos: on the heap of sticks and dry leaves at the near edge of frame, back to camera
characters.space_fragment_en: standing on the heap of sticks and dry leaves at the screen-left edge, seen from behind, facing down the long passage
characters.facing: squarely down the passage on the lens axis; the Rabbit is far ahead of her and never turns to meet her look

beats.action: she registers the waistcoat before she registers the animal
beats.sync: distance discipline: the frame never closes on him

performance_beat.objective: make sense of a rabbit in a waistcoat without letting it out of her sight
performance_beat.goal: make sense of what she is looking at
performance_beat.emotional_arc: from post-landing orientation to a fixed, silent astonishment held entirely in the back of her head and shoulders

trigger.beat: the checked silk waistcoat resolves out of the far lamplight

performance_beat.end_state: unmoving silhouette at the frame edge, head level, shoulders squared down the passage

characters.label: White Rabbit
characters.start_pos: far down the root-laced earth stretch, in profile, hurrying away from her
characters.space_fragment_en: standing on four legs far down the root-laced earth stretch, centred in frame, side-on and hurrying away from Alice
characters.facing: side-on to the lens, travelling away down the passage; he never looks back at Alice and is given no return look

path.to: further down the root-laced earth stretch, nearing the brick-vaulted passage

beats.action: hurrying on four legs, the pair of white kid gloves carried in his mouth
beats.sync: gait and props locked per the H3S ruling

beats.action: one ear flicks at nothing; no look back

characters.staging_lock: Quadruped gait and mouth-carry are locked (CR-003 / CR-015 and the G4 char-sheet waiver, ratified by the user at H3S). He is never given hands to carry with while trotting.

performance_beat.objective: get down the passage before whatever is waiting for him notices he is late
performance_beat.goal: get down the passage before he is missed
performance_beat.emotional_arc: from hurry to greater hurry — no arc of discovery, because he has not discovered her

trigger.beat: he clears the last of the root curtain and the passage opens ahead of him

performance_beat.end_state: still in profile, still going away, gloves gripped in his mouth, ears laid back along his skull

presence_check.note: Alice and the dream-layer White Rabbit; nobody else in the passage.
